name: Brutal
description: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

name: Defensive
description: Attack rolls against you have disadvantage unless the adversary marks a Stress.

name: Grappling
description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Focus to make the target temporarily Restrained.

name: Steady
description: Gain a -1 penalty to your Evasion. When you deal damage on a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and drop the lowest.

name: Precise
description: Gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls.

name: Quick
description: When making an attack roll, spend a Focus to include an additional target within range.

name: Deadly
description: When you deal Severe damage, the target marks an additional HP.

name: Hindering
description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Focus to make the target temporarily Hindered. While Hindered, their attack rolls have a -2 penalty.

name: Invigorating
description: When you make a successful attack, roll a d4. On a 4, gain a Focus.

name: Immovable
description: Gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds and you cannot be moved unwillingly.

name: Nimble
description: When an adversary makes a successful attack roll against you, you can spend a number of Focus up to your Tier. Roll a number of d6s equal to 1 + the Focus spent. If any of the dice values match, you take no damage from the attack.

name: Otherworldly
description: You can choose whether to do Physical or Magic damage.

name: Scary
description: Successful attacks also force the target to mark a Stress.

name: Deflecting
description: When you are targeted by an attack, you can spend 2 Focus to gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to your Armor Score against the attack.

name: Devastating
description: Spend a Focus before your attack roll to use d20s as your damage dice instead.

name: Dueling
description: Gain advantage on attack rolls when there are no other adversaries or allies in Very Close range of you or your target.

name: Compounding
description: When you roll the maximum value on a Combo Die, increase the size of the subsequent Combo Dice you roll for the attack (at a maximum of d12s).

name: Inexorable
description: Attacks against you have disadvantage if you have more than two adversaries within Melee of you.

name: Favored
description: Add the trait of your choice to your damage roll.

name: Sheltering
description: When you mark an Armor Slot, it reduces damage for you and all allies within Melee range of you who took the same damage.

name: Crushing
description: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, it can be treated as the highest value on the die instead.

name: Infuriating
description: On a successful attack, the target becomes Furious. While Furious, they are Vulnerable and have a -2 penalty to their attack rolls. They can only clear Furious by succeeding on an attack against you.

name: Sweeping
description: Your attack targets all adversaries within Very Close range. Deal half damage to all targets you succeed against.

name: Discerning
description: You may choose the target of your attack after making your attack roll. The GM will tell you who the attack would succeed against.
